label: Klaviyo
description: Read profiles, lists, segments, campaigns, flows, and metrics, and prepare email templates and draft campaigns for a person to send.
securityDescription: Klaviyo connects with a private API key entered on Composio's hosted page; Chickpea never receives the key. Within that key's scopes, Agents can read profiles, lists, segments, campaigns and their messages, flows, templates, metrics, events, tags, and campaign and flow reports. With write access, Agents can create and rename lists, create profiles and edit their names, titles, and locations, create and edit email templates, attach a template to a draft campaign message, rename a draft campaign, and estimate a campaign's recipients. A new profile can carry a phone number but no email address. Agents cannot send, schedule, or cancel campaigns or change when they send, choose who a campaign goes to, add profiles to lists, change subscriptions, consent, or suppressions, set or change email addresses, change phone numbers or IDs, remove profile properties, record events, turn flows on or off, change segments or catalog items, delete anything, or manage webhooks or account settings.

drop.KLAVIYO_ADD_PROFILE_TO_LIST: Joining a list starts that list's flows, which can email or text the profile.
drop.KLAVIYO_CREATE_EVENT: A new event can start metric-triggered flows that email or text the profile.
drop.KLAVIYO_CREATE_OR_UPDATE_PROFILE: Matches an existing profile by phone number or external ID and can change those identifiers; create and update cover the same fields.
drop.KLAVIYO_GET_BULK_UPDATE_CATEGORIES_JOB: Polls catalog jobs, and no catalog tool is included.

KLAVIYO_UPDATE_CAMPAIGN.excluded_audiences: Picks who the campaign skips; a person chooses the audience before sending, as with Mailchimp drafts.
KLAVIYO_UPDATE_CAMPAIGN.included_audiences: Picks who the campaign goes to; a person chooses the audience before sending, as with Mailchimp drafts.
KLAVIYO_UPDATE_CAMPAIGN.send_strategy_method: Picks how the campaign sends, including immediately; a person schedules the send, as with Mailchimp drafts.
KLAVIYO_UPDATE_CAMPAIGN.static_is_local_timezone: Sends in each recipient's time zone; a person schedules the send, as with Mailchimp drafts.
KLAVIYO_UPDATE_CAMPAIGN.static_send_datetime: Sets when the campaign sends; a person schedules the send, as with Mailchimp drafts.
KLAVIYO_UPDATE_CAMPAIGN.sto_send_date: Sets the Smart Send Time date; a person schedules the send, as with Mailchimp drafts.
KLAVIYO_UPDATE_CAMPAIGN.throttle_percentage: Sets how fast the campaign sends; a person schedules the send, as with Mailchimp drafts.
KLAVIYO_UPDATE_CAMPAIGN.throttled_send_datetime: Sets when a throttled campaign starts sending; a person schedules the send, as with Mailchimp drafts.

KLAVIYO_UPDATE_PROFILE.data__attributes__anonymous__id: Changes an identifier Klaviyo uses to match the profile to a person, like email, phone number, and external ID.
KLAVIYO_UPDATE_PROFILE.data__meta__patch__properties__unset: Deletes custom profile properties outright, and the old values cannot be restored.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `1/s`

data__type.description: Resource type for the campaign values report request. Must be 'campaign-values-report'.

Allowed operators: equals, contains-any. Only one filter can be used per attribute, only AND can be used as a combination operator. Max of 100 campaign IDs per contains-any filter.

data__attributes__statistics.description: List of statistics to query for. All rate statistics will be returned in fractional form [0.0, 1.0]. Common aliases are supported: 'average_open_rate' maps to 'open_rate', 'count_opened' maps to 'opens', 'count_sent' maps to 'recipients'.

data__attributes__conversion__metric__id.description: Required. ID of the metric for calculating conversion-based statistics (e.g., 'Placed Order' metric). Use Get Metrics API to find valid metric IDs. Note: Use purchase/order event metrics (not engagement metrics like 'Opened Email') to avoid 'does not support querying for values data' errors.

capabilities.description:

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `1/s`
Steady: `2/m`
Daily: `225/d` **Scopes:** `flows:read`

data__type.description: Resource type for the flow values report request. Must be 'flow-values-report'.

data__attributes__filter.description: Filter string to narrow results. Accepts either a plain filter string like 'equals(send_channel,"email")' or a JSON-encoded array like '["equals(flow_id,"ABC123")"]' (which will be automatically converted). Supported filters: flow_id, send_channel, flow_message_id. Supported operators: equals (for SINGLE value, e.g., 'equals(flow_id,"ABC123")'), contains-any (for MULTIPLE values, e.g., 'contains-any(flow_id,["ABC123","DEF456"])'). Only one filter per attribute, only AND for combining.

data__attributes__statistics.description: List of statistics to query for. All rate statistics will be returned in fractional form [0.0, 1.0]. Common aliases are supported: 'average_open_rate' maps to 'open_rate', 'count_opened' maps to 'opens', 'count_sent' maps to 'recipients'.

data__attributes__conversion_metric_id.description: ID of the conversion metric (e.g., 'Placed Order' metric ID) required for ALL flow values report queries. This metric is used for calculating conversion-based statistics, but the endpoint will return all requested statistics regardless of conversion status. For example, 'opens' will include all opens whether or not they resulted in conversions. Get metric IDs from the Get Metrics endpoint.

withheldArguments.data__attributes__external__id: changes who the record belongs to or how a person is identified
withheldArguments.data__attributes__organization: changes sharing, visibility, permissions, membership, or who acts
withheldArguments.data__attributes__anonymous__id: reviewer: Changes an identifier Klaviyo uses to match the profile to a person, like email, phone number, and external ID.
withheldArguments.data__attributes__phone__number: changes who the record belongs to or how a person is identified
withheldArguments.data__meta__patch__properties__unset: reviewer: Deletes custom profile properties outright, and the old values cannot be restored.

id.description: Primary key that uniquely identifies this profile. Generated by Klaviyo.

data__id.description: Primary key that uniquely identifies this profile. Generated by Klaviyo.

data__attributes__image.description: URL pointing to the location of a profile image

data__attributes__location__region.description: Region within a country, such as state or province

data__attributes__location__latitude.description: Latitude coordinate. We recommend providing a precision of four decimal places.

data__attributes__location__timezone.description: Time zone name. We recommend using time zones from the IANA Time Zone Database.

data__attributes__location__longitude.description: Longitude coordinate. We recommend providing a precision of four decimal places.

capabilities.description: Update an existing email template by ID. Supports updating name, HTML content, and plaintext content. Note: This action only works with CODE editor type templates; drag & drop templates cannot be updated via API. Rate limits: Burst 10/s, Steady 150/m. Requires 'templates:write' scope.

id.description: The unique identifier of the template to update. Used in the URL path.

data__id.description: The template ID in the request body. Must match the 'id' path parameter.

data__attributes__html.description: The new HTML content for the template. Only works with CODE editor type templates, not drag & drop templates.

data__attributes__name.description: The new name for the template. Optional - only include if updating the name.

data__attributes__text.description: The new plaintext version of the template. This is the fallback content for email clients that don't support HTML.
